d:
A three-storey under-construction building collapsed in Old Delhi’s Chawri Bazaar today morning, leaving at least two people dead and up to 15 feared trapped under the debris. Police said the incident was reported at 9.50 am from Gali Sitara, close to the Chawri Bazaar Metro station. Watch the report to know more.
